brand.name: Builders
brand.tagline: Where bold founders build stellar companies.
brand.oneLiner: The AI venture studio — a 10-week program with staged capital.
brand.description: Where bold founders build stellar companies. The AI venture studio — firepower, the VSI platform, and on-the-ground execution.

toc.logo: Wordmark, inverse, the spark. Clear space and rules.
toc.colors: Two grounds, four accents, the phase scale.
toc.typography: Favorit XB, Favorit, Instrument Serif, DM Mono.
toc.messaging: Voice, headline formula, the hard bans.

logo.intro: The wordmark opens with the four-pointed spark. Black on cream, white on deep ink. Nothing in between.
logo.clearSpace: Preserve clear space equal to the height of the spark on all four sides. On photography, place the white wordmark over the darkest region of the frame or over a gradient scrim.
dos: Black wordmark on cream and light surfaces.
White wordmark on deep ink, photography, gradients.
donts: No recoloring into the accent palette.
No busy photography without a scrim.

colors.intro: Two grounds carry everything. Four accents, one per pillar, appear as chips, data, and gradient stops — never as body text.

groups.name: Grounds
groups.description: Every asset is a dark card on Deep Ink or a light card on Cream.

swatches.name: Cream
swatches.usage: Light ground. Print and logo stage.

swatches.name: Ink
swatches.usage: Text on cream. Never pure black.

groups.name: Accents
groups.description: One color per pillar of the studio.

scale.name: Phase scale
scale.description: The five-step ramp for program phases and staged sequences — always in this order.

colors.note: White on Deep Ink and Ink on Cream both clear WCAG 2.1 AA for body text. Accents are for large display and non-text use.

typography.intro: Four voices: Favorit XB shouts the headline, Favorit carries the body, Instrument Serif italic adds the single flourish, DM Mono whispers the kickers.

fonts.name: Instrument Serif Italic
fonts.stack: 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif · italic, one phrase per asset

pairing.headline:
Where bold founders
build stellar companies.
pairing.body: Ten weeks in the studio. Staged capital as you hit milestones. A team on the ground beside you, and the VSI platform underneath everything you ship.

spacing.intro: A 4px base grid. Generous outer margins, tight internal stacks. One large radius per card; type sits on the grid.

photography.intro: Real studio photography only — events, founders, the work. When there is no photo, the brand gradients take its place.

style.label: Subject
style.value: Real people at real moments — founders presenting, rooms mid-conversation, the city the studio works from.

style.label: Light
style.value: Ambient and honest. Event light as it was; no strobes, no staging.

style.label: Treatment
style.value: A gradient scrim (ink 0.5 → 0.85, vertical) whenever type sits on the image.

style.label: Gradients
style.value: Solid variants for flat backgrounds, alpha variants layered over photos.

dos: Photography from the studio's own library.
A third of the frame quiet for type.
Scrim before setting white copy on an image.
donts: No heavy grading over the accents.

signatures.name: Flip-clock countdown
signatures.note: Deadline tiles, baked at render time — regenerate the morning you post.

signatures.name: Fanned avatars
signatures.note: The overlapping headshot strip for community and batch posts.

signatures.name: Boarding-pass ticket
signatures.note: The event-invite card: perforation, stub, and all.

signatures.name: Phase chips
signatures.note: The five-color scale marking program phases and staged sequences.

messaging.intro: How Builders sounds — on the site, in posts, at events. This chapter is what downstream tools read first.

voice.style: Short declaratives. Concrete numbers and dates. The studio talks like a founder who has shipped, not like a fund that observes. One serif-italic flourish per asset — the emphasis, never the whole line.

formula.pattern: [KICKER IN DM MONO] + [Declarative in Favorit XB, one serif-italic emphasis]
formula.guidance: Supporting copy: what happens, when, and for whom — three sentences at most. CTA: a date beats an adjective (“Applications close August 15” over “Apply now”).

claims.label: The program — idea to company, in the studio, on a clock.
Capital released as milestones land, not up front.
The venture intelligence platform underneath every venture.

headlines: Ten weeks. Staged capital. A team on the ground.
dos: Lead with what happens and when.
Real numbers, real dates, real events.
One serif-italic flourish per asset, at most.
donts: Banned phrasings: founder counts, “one crew”, “side by side”, “prove it in ten weeks”, “the work is the application”.
Don't bake a countdown and post it days later.
Don't stack more than one idea per sentence.
